source.aggregate_algorithm: SHA256 of concatenated raw per-file SHA256 digests in retained sorted path order; path bindings are additionally recorded in the full manifest and Git tree.

reviewed_contract: Original partial Cueglint extractive highlights contract; not reference automatic notes, summary, decisions/action items, salience or whole-product parity.
source_checks: Generation is explicit, local-only and requires stopped/nonempty finalized transcript. Hosted answer selection does not route highlights to a remote provider. Manual notes, title and legacy summary remain separate.

Core/local freeze exact ordered transcript IDs/text/speaker/source and digest, cap complete source128KiB/10000 utterances, declare complete ordered coverage before any job/model generation, and reject oversized single utterances or more than16 chunks rather than selecting a suffix.

Prepared opaque prompts/token IDs bind a verified local model/tokenizer. Each chunk reserves128 output tokens in4096 total; strict JSON indices must be ordered, unique, within the declared chunk and at most8. Source text is quoted/role delimiters escaped. Stored highlights are cloned exact whole utterances with byte spans, not model-generated prose.

Local chunk/model/prompt/token/finish identities are checked. Cancellation, invalid/truncated output or any chunk failure returns no completion; progress carries counts only and no partial draft is committed.

Existing two-slot inference actor owns preparation/run and cache. Operation/session/source/profile/root/token bind both phases; run additionally binds current job ID and same cancellation Arc. Model/file/provider/capture/answer overlap guards prevent conflicting use.

Store begin rechecks full source before pending job creation. Runtime matches exact binding and current profile/root; retired and older events cannot publish or clear a newer operation. Navigation/source/resume/profile/root/quit paths cancel; ready and accepted records survive cancellation.

Append drains all dirty manual saves/ACKs before capturing acknowledged notes_revision. Exact typed operation/session/action ACK locks/unlocks the editor independently of manual Notes ACK. Derived snapshots preserve dirty buffers and cannot clear notes_saving. CAS conflict preserves notes, latches explicit review and does not auto-retry.

Core append checks accepted ID/revision in one transaction, bounds the combined text, increments revision only for byte changes and records applied revision. Already-applied results preserve subsequent edits. Accept/Discard do not modify manual notes.

Deferred navigation waits even when Generate ACK has not yet arrived; once the job is acknowledged it is cancelled and the navigation waits for terminal actor event. Quit retires deferred append/session actions and waits beyond Cancel command ACK.

Schema2 adds optional/defaulted notes fields; v1 settings/session/backups remain readable. Strict unknown/malformed notes/session/inference records reject before replacement transaction. Restore sorts transcript before validation, retires imported pending notes and preserves ready/accepted records. Store open recovers only interrupted notes in CLI; GUI recording recovery remains separate.

Reconciled provider config and hosted provenance survive v1-to-v2 restore/export. New regression rejects forged highlights atomically while preserving hosted metadata and human notes. No credential is added to portable records.

CLI review/accept/discard/append uses the same Core validation/CAS; actual local generation is explicit. Missing model/preparation failures create no pending job, and completion/cancellation errors retire pending notes without publishing a partial result.

limitations_and_remaining: Evaluator performed bounded source/static/hash/log inspection only: no builds/tests, CLI/model/network/keychain calls, native windows/CUA or source/registry edits.

229-pass workspace run has two explicit native credential filters and three configured-model/oracle ignores. It is not an unfiltered all-feature acceptance run. Root must combine v2/provider UI changes and run appropriate unfiltered tests, fmt and progress before publishing.

No real highlight generation, salience/coverage-quality scoring, native review window/OS IME/focus or capture route tested by evaluator. Supplied selections and typed fake actor events validate protocol, not model usefulness.

Whole-utterance extraction preserves uncertainty literally but does not establish useful meeting summaries, generated titles, owners, dates, commitments or reference automatic trigger/regeneration parity.

Cancellation is cooperative; terminal actor event is required before quit/navigation completes. Idle inference thread is not joined; abrupt interruption is recovered on next Store open. No hard kernel/model-load latency guarantee is claimed.
No GUI restore command or generic Store epoch is added. Scope relies on one locked Store actor and exact operation/session/source identities; external direct database corruption/ABA is not addressed.

Local model/profile/root and token limits are pinned by code; actual original-fixture quality must be planned/frozen and measured separately after root integration. Earlier ASR, CI/native and provider failures remain historical.
Original Core/local implementation was rechecked by byte identity with its previous reviewed endpoint; current review concentrates on additive desktop/actor/CLI and provider migration integration.
